rows.label: Lua Thrax Plasm
rows.note: build cost; 5 guaranteed per rotation plus 30% per Thrax

conditions: Keep 50 Plasm for the build; people spend it on parts and then can't craft.
Stay the full 20 minutes: rotations run A, A, B, C.
Circulus Thrax go spectral when downed and must be finished with the Operator's Void Beam, or they don't drop.
Thrax Plasm despawns after 60 seconds; pick it up right after each wave.
bonuses: Resource Boosters and Smeeta Kavat double the Plasm Thrax drop, not the guaranteed rotation Plasm; drop chance boosters do nothing.
Run it during an Omnia Fissure on Circulus to crack relics and get endless-fissure buffs.
Summon your Necramech for the Thrax waves; it lasts 2 minutes on a 10-minute cooldown.
Voruna and Sarofang drop from the same node and spend the same Plasm.

disclosures.title: Circulus over Yuvarium
disclosures.body: Yuvarium pays 3 Plasm a rotation and 7.52% blueprint, 6% per part. Circulus pays 5 and roughly doubles the odds; Steel Path Circulus pays 6. Loot abilities don't work on Thrax, so bring whatever kills fastest. Thrax alive on the map drain life support 50% faster, and one can get stuck in spectral form; ignore it.

disclosures.title: streaky parts
disclosures.body: Players report stacking 5-13 copies of one part while never seeing another. Stop grinding once buying the missing piece from Yonta is cheaper. The three parts are tradeable and cheap from other players.
